caption: The drawing is a monochromatic architectural design rendered in pencil on a beige or off-white background. It depicts two orthogonal views of a bed with an ornamental canopy and curtains: an “END VIEW” on the left and a “SIDE VIEW” on the right. The bed features posts and a curved canopy above, adorned on the end view with vertical, curving floral vines on the headboard and what appears to be decorative flowers. The canopy edges are scalloped and lightly detailed, with drapes or curtains hanging from it. The bed itself is rectangular, with dimensions and scale markings included; it has a decorative panel above the mattress and a skirt or valance below, illustrated with vertical lines to suggest fabric folds. The drawing includes dimension indicators in inches along the top and sides of each view and a scale bar at the bottom marked in inches. In the lower right corner is a labeled box containing text: “BED,” “BED ROOM,” “CORBIN HOUSE,” and “BROOKLYN MUSEUM,” along with a number (#15800). Handwritten text reading “B. Holt. Grubbe” is visible in the lower left margin.
title: Bed
